checked_profile.summary: Loans with purpose-dependent pricing and an AutoPay condition on advertised rates.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Amounts and fees
facts.text: LightStream advertises fixed-rate loans of $5,000–$100,000, with no lender fees or prepayment penalties. State taxes may still apply.

facts.label: Rate conditions
facts.text: APR depends on purpose, amount, repayment term and credit profile. The lowest rate requires excellent credit; this profile does not treat one purpose-specific range as the rate for every loan.

facts.label: AutoPay
facts.text: Quoted rates include AutoPay. Without it, rates are 0.50 percentage points higher. The discount must be arranged before funding.

questions: What APR, origination fee and net deposit are in my actual offer?
